title: Dialogue 4 opening: That the Son is neither creature nor made thing
english: Dialogue 4 — That the Son is neither creature nor made thing.
A opens against those who class the Son with things made. “Firstborn of creation” and similar phrases are not allowed to mean he is one creature among creatures; begotten is not made.
Hermias is led to see that craft and begetting are not the same relation.
translator_notes: Copy-text: PG 75 De sancta et consubstantiali Trinitate dialogi (CPG 5216).
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Condensed lemma-led tip.
Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify. No Durand SC / modern English sync as base.
